title: How to handle grief at work and beyond
author: Meredith Wilson Parfet

value.text: My life has not been perfect, and I find that deeply annoying.
For better or worse, I've faced crisis across every part of it.
When it's personal, it's hard to know how to survive.
When it's professional, suffering at work, not allowed.

More taboo, what if something bad happens at work?
Bankruptcy, layoffs, a failed startup.
